flashcard_questions.q: A situation where a business has more money going out than coming in over a period of time.
Money a business borrows or uses for a short period, usually less than one year, to cover day-to-day costs.
A facility that allows a business to spend more money than it has in its bank account, up to an agreed limit.

flashcard_questions.a: An agreement where a supplier allows a business to receive goods now and pay for them at a later date, usually 30 to 60 days.
Money raised by a business that is repaid over more than one year, used for major investments like premises or equipment.
